dependencies.license: MIT; upstream package LICENSE retained on GPU node
dependencies.download: GPU NETWORK_INTERFACE direct, no proxy, registry IP 104.16.10.34 obtained using DNS-over-HTTPS

decisions.geometry: Load actual SHA256-checked width-proxy OBJ parts, not replacement primitives
decisions.motion: Only explicit source-labeled configuration; no default pivots or physical ranges. Scene presentation defaults are camera/light settings only.
decisions.mapping: Piecewise-linear signal/joint coordinate mapping, neutral fixed at zero for stick axes. This is inspection interpolation, not a measured sensor calibration.
decisions.composition: Configured transforms composed in file order about neutral-world axes/pivots; not an inferred internal mechanism
decisions.drag: Revolute: signed ray-plane angle about configured axis. Prismatic: ray-view-plane displacement projected onto axis, corrected for foreshortening; reject near-end-on views.
decisions.reset: Immediate kinematic reset or explicit hold; no claim of spring dynamics
decisions.configuration_evidence: A provenance string is required but not semantically verified. Loading a file never approves its physics.
decisions.server: Loopback only; explicit roots and no directory listing
decisions.harness: tests/test_gamepad_state.mjs, tests/test_rig.mjs plus real browser inspection; real-device gate remains separate
